part4.title: Part 4 – Factual Text
part4.instruction: Read the text. Choose the right words and write them on the lines.
paragraphs: Parrots are famous for being some of the most colorful birds in the world. Most parrots live (1) ________ warm rainforests in South America, Africa and Australia.
Parrots have strong curved beaks which they use to crack open tough nuts and seeds. They are very good at climbing tree trunks because (2) ________ toes can grip branches tightly.
Parrots are extremely social animals. They live together (3) ________ large groups called flocks and spend their day searching for delicious fruit and berries.
Some intelligent parrots can learn to imitate human speech. People who have parrots as pets are often (4) ________ when their bird says 'Hello!' or repeats simple words.
Wild parrots love flying fast across the sky in pairs or family groups. They communicate by making loud, high squeaks (5) ________ calls.
In the wild, parrots build nests in hollow holes high up inside old tree trunks. This keeps their small eggs safe (6) ________ snakes and other dangerous climbing animals.
Scientists believe that parrots are among the (7) ________ birds on Earth because they can solve complex puzzles to get food!
Parrots can live for a very long time. Small parrots live for 15 years, (8) ________ large parrots can live for more than 50 years!
When parrots eat, they (9) ________ hold their food with one foot while eating with their beak.
They are truly (10) ________ wonderful creatures to watch in nature.

part5.title: Part 5 – Complete Sentences about the Story
part5.instruction: Look at the pictures and read the story. Write 1, 2 or 3 words to complete the sentences about the story.
part5.storyTitle: 🦁 A trip to the Jungle Zoo

storyPassages.text: Last Tuesday morning, Mrs White took her class on an exciting trip to the Jungle Hill Zoo. The children were thrilled because they travelled to the zoo by train! Paul and his friend Ben sat together near the window. In the zoo reference book Mrs White brought, it said there were 89 different kinds of animals living at the zoo.

When they arrived at the zoo, the children saw huge grey elephants first. Ben thought the elephants were the biggest animals at the zoo! Then they walked to the parrot house. The parrots were bright green, red and blue. The zoo keeper allowed the children to feed fresh fruit to the noisy parrots. Paul said parrots were his absolute favourite animal.

At lunchtime, all the children sat together near the park café to eat the packed sandwiches their parents made for them. In the evening, before getting back onto the train home, Mrs White bought everyone hot burgers and cold lemonade. It was a perfect ending to a wonderful day!

The children were allowed to feed fresh ________ to the parrots.
Paul said that colorful ________ were his favourite animals.
The children ate their packed lunch next to the zoo ________.
In the evening, Mrs White bought everyone hot ________ and lemonade.
The children drank cold ________ with their evening meal.
Mrs White's class went back home on the ________ in the evening.
All the children had a ________ day at the zoo.
